texts.title: QAZI TOUQEER
texts.bio: The iconic singer and powerhouse stage performer. From winning national hearts to lighting up the stage with Salman Khan, Qazi delivers an adrenaline-fueled arena experience for College Fests, Stadium Arenas, Royal Sangeets, and VIP Events.
texts.celebrityBadge: FAME GURUKUL WINNER • BIGG BOSS PHENOMENON • AFGHAN JALEBI FAME
texts.punchline: “Awaaz Jo Dil Se Nikle, Stage Pe Aag Laga De”
